mapper.sql: FROM model_runtime.controlled_model_catalog_entry catalog JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_deployment deployment ON deployment.id = catalog.source_platform_deployment_id JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_deployment_publication publication ON publication.catalog_entry_id = catalog.id AND publication.deployment_id = deployment.id AND publication.deployment_revision = deployment.version JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection ON connection.id = deployment.platform_provider_connection_id JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_capability_verification verification ON verification.id = publication.verification_id AND verification.id = deployment.last_verification_id JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_deployment_verification_audit audit ON audit.verification_id = verification.id AND audit.succeeded = TRUE JOIN model_runtime.platform_capability_verification_reservation reservation ON reservation.id = audit.reservation_id WHERE catalog.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deployment.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deployment.version = catalog.source_platform_deployment_revision AND deployment.verification_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND connection.version = deployment.platform_provider_connection_revision AND connection.last_probe_succeeded = TRUE AND connection.last_probed_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND connection.last_probed_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication connection_publication WHERE connection_publication.connection_id = connection.id AND connection_publication.connection_revision = connection.version) AND catalog.provider_kind = connection.provider_kind AND catalog.endpoint = connection.endpoint AND catalog.model_code = deployment.model_code AND catalog.model_type = deployment.model_type AND catalog.context_window = deployment.context_window AND catalog.output_limit IS NOT DISTINCT FROM deployment.output_limit AND catalog.embedding_dimension IS NOT DISTINCT FROM deployment.embedding_dimension AND catalog.rerank_candidate_limit IS NOT DISTINCT FROM deployment.rerank_candidate_limit AND verification.succeeded = TRUE AND verification.result_code = 'S2_PASSED' AND verification.expires_at = deployment.verification_expires_at AND reservation.status = 'COMPLETED' AND reservation.outcome = 'PASSED' AND reservation.attempted_requests = 3 AND reservation.sample_version = 's2-capability-safety-v1' AND reservation.passed_sample_digests = reservation.expected_sample_digests AND publication.inputs_digest = reservation.inputs_digest AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision) id, platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, discovered_at, expires_at FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery WHERE succeeded = TRUE ORDER BY platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, discovered_at DESC, id DESC ) discovery JOIN model_runtime.platform_discovered_model candidate ON candidate.discovery_id = discovery.id WHERE discovery.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision = connection.version AND discovery.id = deployment.candidate_discovery_id AND discovery.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND discovery.discovered_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND candidate.model_code = deployment.model_code AND (candidate.source_profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'SILICONFLOW_RERANK_MODELS_API' OR (candidate.mapping_version = #{mappingVersion} AND candidate.mapping_digest = #{mappingDigest})))
mapper.select:
SELECT catalog.*
ORDER BY catalog.created_at DESC, catalog.id DESC
SELECT catalog.* AND deployment.id = #{deploymentId} AND deployment.version = #{revision}

SELECT connection.id FROM model_runtime.controlled_model_catalog_entry catalog JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_deployment deployment ON deployment.id = catalog.source_platform_deployment_id JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection ON connection.id = deployment.platform_provider_connection_id WHERE catalog.id = #{entryId} AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.version = deployment.platform_provider_connection_revision AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' FOR SHARE OF connection

SELECT deployment.id FROM model_runtime.platform_model_deployment deployment JOIN model_runtime.controlled_model_catalog_entry catalog ON catalog.source_platform_deployment_id = deployment.id WHERE catalog.id = #{entryId} AND deployment.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deployment.version = catalog.source_platform_deployment_revision FOR SHARE OF deployment

SELECT g.publication_id FROM model_runtime.platform_model_supply_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT catalog.id AND catalog.id = #{entryId} AND publication.id = g.publication_id) FOR SHARE OF g
